name: drishti-agent
//: @effect/platform-node satisfies the hydrated @kolu/surface transports the agent serves and dials (peer-server's NodeStream/NodeSink stdio pair, unix-socket's NodeSocket). @kolu/surface, @kolu/surface-daemon and @kolu/surface-daemon-supervisor are hydrated from the Nix store, not bun.lock — so the agent build, which excludes packages/app, must declare the runtime deps of those hydrated sources itself. `effect` backs the durable history ring schemas, surface-daemon's control core, the whole RPC stack, AND @kolu/surface/reactor's signal graph — the reactor runs on Effect's Atom now, so @preact/signals-core is gone from kolu and from here. `ts-pattern` is a RUNTIME import of the supervisor kit (probeDaemonIdentity / index), which the --stdio front runs to converge before relaying (juspay/kolu#2101); @kolu/log needs no entry because surface-daemon takes it as `import type` only.
